edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource.

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 765.

note.en: Dong the Elder is usually identified as the qin master Dong Tinglan, and Gao Shi, poor and unknown himself at the time, saw him off in a snowstorm. The first couplet is all weather; the second is pure encouragement, the opposite of the usual farewell. Wikisource gives two poems under this title, and this is the first.
note.zh: 董大一般认为是琴师董庭兰。高适当时自己也贫困不得志，在风雪里送他远行。前两句全是天气，后两句全是鼓励，与一般送别诗正好相反。维基文库此题下有两首，这是第一首。

excerpt.orig: 莫愁前路無知己，天下誰人不識君。
excerpt.en: Do not worry that on the road ahead you will have no friends: / under heaven, who is there who does not know you?
excerpt.zh: 莫愁前路无知己，天下谁人不识君。

gloss.en: Yellow clouds: a dark, dust-laden winter sky.
gloss.zh: 黄云：天空中的乌云，在日光下呈暗黄色。

gloss.en: 曛: dim, the failing light of the sun.
A friend who truly knows you.
Dong the Elder is usually identified as Dong Tinglan, a famous qin player of the day, so the reassurance is literally true.
gloss.zh: 董大一般认为指当时著名的琴师董庭兰，因此“天下谁人不识君”并非虚言。
